raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Overview

Proof of concept: on Hopper with expert parallel, run DeepSeek V4 / V4.1 MXFP4 experts on Humming with block FP8 (group 128) activations by default instead of BF16. Related to #59488 (opt-in `--quantization-config.moe.activation` for the same method), which this would rebase onto.

## Claims

- DeepSeek-V4-Flash, TP4 + EP on H200: +25% decode output throughput (TPOT 25.2 -> 20.0 ms) and +6% prefill-heavy throughput, with GSM8K unchanged.
- Scope: `Mxfp4MoEMethod` with the HUMMING backend, DeepSeek V4 routing (V4 and V4.1), expert parallel, SM90. Everything else keeps the current BF16 default, and `VLLM_HUMMING_INPUT_QUANT_CONFIG` still overrides.

## Validation

DeepSeek-V4-Flash on 4x H200, Humming MoE backend (the SM90 default). Baseline is `main` (BF16 activations). The FP8 column was measured with `VLLM_HUMMING_INPUT_QUANT_CONFIG='{"a_dtype": "float8e4m3", "input_scale_group_size": 128}'`. That override resolves to the same Humming layer config as this PR's `kFp8Dynamic128Sym` (group 128, `DynamicGroup`, float32 scales on SM90).

| Config | Workload | BF16 (main) | FP8 GS128 | Change |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| TP4 + EP | GSM8K 5-shot (1319 q) | 0.951 | 0.948 | within noise |
| TP4 + EP | decode: 512 in / 1024 out, conc 128 (3 runs) | 4757 / 4911 / 4906 tok/s | 6131 / 6135 / 6128 tok/s | **+25%** |
| TP4 + EP | prefill: 8192 in / 64 out, conc 32 | 28939 tok/s total | 30780 tok/s total | +6.4% |
| TP4 + EP | low concurrency: 2048 in / 512 out, conc 4 | 422.6 tok/s | 421.0 tok/s | -0.4% |
| TP4 (no EP) | GSM8K 5-shot | 0.948 | 0.951 | within noise |
| TP4 (no EP) | decode (1 run) | 5249 tok/s | 4473 tok/s | -15% |
| TP4 (no EP) | prefill | 29873 tok/s total | 30309 tok/s total | +1.5% |
| TP4 (no EP) | low concurrency | 485.9 tok/s | 455.9 tok/s | -6% |

```bash
vllm serve deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4-Flash --tensor-parallel-size 4 --enable-expert-parallel --max-model-len 16384
python tests/evals/gsm8k/gsm8k_eval.py --port 8000 --max-concurrency 256
vllm bench serve --model deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4-Flash --dataset-name random \
  --random-input-len 512 --random-output-len 1024 --num-prompts 512 --max-concurrency 128 --ignore-eos
```

Tests: `pytest tests/quantization/test_humming_mxfp4_block_fp8.py` passes (11). The new test fails without the source change.

## Details

DeepSeek V4 MXFP4 experts go through `Mxfp4MoEMethod`, which passes no activation key. On SM90 the Humming backend then builds its input schema from `VLLM_HUMMING_INPUT_QUANT_CONFIG` and defaults to BF16. This PR sets `activation_key = kFp8Dynamic128Sym` in that case. #59815 already plumbs the key into Humming's input schema with fallback disabled. The DeepSeek V4 checkpoint declares block FP8 GS128 with UE8M0 scales for its FP8 layers, so block FP8 matches what the model was built for.

Why only with EP: under EP each rank runs full-size experts (hidden 4096, intermediate 2048), where Humming's FP8 x MXFP4 kernels are faster. Under TP4 the intermediate is split to 512 per rank, and dynamic activation quantization costs more than it saves. Gating on DeepSeek V4 routing keeps other MXFP4 models (Kimi K3, plain mxfp4) unchanged.

Limitations:
- DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash was not run; it shares the routing and method, so it gets the same default. #59488 reports the indexed GEMM is faster for V4.1 with EP on Hopper, and the FP8 gain should be re-measured on that path.
- Measured on H200 with the default all2all backend. DeepEP v2 and H100/H20 were not measured.
- The FP8 column was measured with the equivalent env override. I could not rerun end to end on this exact build because the shared machine's GPUs were taken.
- Not a duplicate: #59488 adds an opt-in activation format for the same method, and this PR changes the default for one configuration. #53184 fuses SwiGLU with per-token FP8 quantization for W2. #53709 dequantizes experts to block FP8 instead.

---

+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    "routing,use_ep,expected",
+    [
+        ("DeepseekV4", True, kFp8Dynamic128Sym),
+        ("DeepseekV4", False, None),
+        ("TopK", True, None),
+    ],
+)
+def test_deepseek_v4_hopper_ep_defaults_to_block_fp8(
+    monkeypatch, routing, use_ep, expected
+):
+    """DeepSeek V4 MXFP4 experts on Humming default to block FP8 activations on
+    SM90 only with EP, where the full-size expert GEMMs gain from them."""
+    import dataclasses
+
+    from tests.kernels.moe.utils import make_dummy_moe_config
+    from vllm.model_executor.layers.fused_moe.config import RoutingMethodType
+    from vllm.model_executor.layers.fused_moe.oracle.mxfp4 import Mxfp4MoeBackend
+    from vllm.model_executor.layers.quantization import mxfp4
+    from vllm.platforms import current_platform
+
+    monkeypatch.setattr(
+        mxfp4,
+        "select_deepseek_v4_mxfp4_moe_backend",
+        lambda moe: (Mxfp4MoeBackend.HUMMING, None),
+    )
+    monkeypatch.setattr(
+        current_platform, "is_device_capability_family", lambda cap: cap == 90
+    )
+    moe = make_dummy_moe_config()
+    moe = dataclasses.replace(
+        moe,
+        routing_method=getattr(RoutingMethodType, routing),
+        moe_parallel_config=dataclasses.replace(moe.moe_parallel_config, use_ep=use_ep),
+    )
+
+    assert mxfp4.Mxfp4MoEMethod(moe).activation_key == expected
